svg.text: Teleoperation data flow with local intent and nudge engine
Target architecture, 2026-10-09. Solid = exists today, dashed = to build. Ages are relative to operator time t (now).
produces: arm and head commands (120 Hz), gaze samples (tagged with video frame id)
holds: cue primitives (haptic pulse, sound, overlay). No thresholds, no decisions
logs: commands, stream metrics, operator view
unchanged, not in the nudge path
one-way network delay (measured round trip ≈ 200 ms)
camera to eye, includes dn​ (encode, buffer, decode, display)
arm tracking lag, reference to measured
perception processing time, not measured yet
cue render time (haptic a few ms, audio buffer more)
Values are approximate, from the September hardware logs.
What the nudge engine knows at time t
t − dn​, reflecting commands sent at t − 2·dn​ − da​
t − dv​ (gaze is matched to it by frame id)
